get_property_from_atoms: retrieve a property from an ASE Atoms object by name from its properties or info dictionary
normalize_property_by_natoms: normalize a property value by dividing it by the number of atoms in an ASE Atoms object
normalize_property_by_other: normalize a property value by dividing it by another property retrieved from an ASE Atoms object
get_property_dict_from_atoms: extract multiple properties from an ASE Atoms object into a dictionary with optional normalization support
get_property_dict_with_normalization: extract properties from an ASE Atoms object and include per-atom or per-property normalized variants in the result
